levels.surface: أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمذاني

notes: Sulayman's own visit to Musa b. Ja'far is a first-person narrative in which the Imam speaks and acts inside the scene; whether Musa is a link is left to a ruling (rule 11), so he is not added.
«أبيه» is a bare relation (rule 7); lexicon names are not filled in.
